articles.title: Health Canada authorizes Gazyva® (obinutuzumab) for adults with active lupus nephritis
articles.mainIdea: Health Canada authorizes Gazyva® (obinutuzumab) for adults with active lupus nephritis
articles.summary: CNW Group: Health Canada authorizes Gazyva® (obinutuzumab) for adults with active lupus nephritis. Hoffmann-La Roche Limited (Roche Canada) is pleased to announce that on January 22, 2026, Health Canada has approved Gazyva® (obinutuzumab) for the treatment of adult patients with active lupus nephritis who are receiving standard therapy. Following four initial doses in the first year, Gazyva can be administered twice yearly, offering an effective and potentially more convenient treatment option than traditional targeted therapies.3
